coverage.reason: States Rule 6c-11 is available to open-end management investment company ETFs and does not cover UIT ETFs.

Says leveraged and inverse ETFs are eligible and that leveraged/inverse status alone does not require separate relief. Notes they must comply with Rule 18f-4 (derivatives risk program, VaR limits, reporting) unless the limited-user exception applies.

Covers non-transparent/semi-transparent ETFs and share-class ETFs needing separate exemptive relief, and names daily holdings disclosure as a condition. Omits master-feeder structures, so the bundle is incomplete.

rationale: There is no central error: leveraged/inverse ETFs are not excluded, UITs are not treated as covered, and nontransparent and share-class ETFs are correctly said to need separate relief. No material local falsehood was found. Points 1 and 2 are fully covered, but point 3 omits master-feeder structures. Total coverage is 2.5 of 3, which meets the partial threshold but not correct, since correct requires every required minimum.
